environment.node: v22.11.0 portable, C:/nasa/.tools/node-v22.11.0-win-x64 (nodejs.org zip, SHA256 905373a059aecaf7f48c1ce10ffbd5334457ca00f678747f19db5ea7d256c236 matched SHASUMS256.txt)

changes.seed: data/packed_seed/ holds the terrain/photo/map payload extracted once from the baseline HTML, with build-derived fields removed (full-resolution photos, world map, PLACES station targets, localTerrain, evidenceMission). seed-manifest.json records per-file SHA256; loadSeed() refuses a mismatched or missing seed. buildUI no longer reads its own output.
changes.grid_check: runPackagedGrid(root) writes mission/report to a fresh temp dir by default. runPackagedGrid(root,{publish:true}) is the explicit product update. The runner hashes mission.json, packaged-grid-validation.json and manifest.json before/after the temp run.
changes.connectivity_provenance: packaged-grid-validation.json now carries provenance {grid_payload_sha256, model_source_sha256 (MAKE_MODEL+WORKER_MAIN source), seed_manifest_sha256, stations_sha256, base, strict, overlay_revision} and a stable id per target. buildUI joins by id only when grid/model/base match; otherwise default_base_reachable=null (unknown), never false. The UI shows 'Route from base not pre-checked' for unknown stations.
changes.evidence: buildEvidence/buildStationCandidates take outDir/catalogPath. Mesh selection is the explicit COMMON_FRAME_MESH_IDS list (PDS4 LIDs, no version); two files with the same LID and different content fail the build. A manifest with status != local_only, a grid_registration, or non-empty masks is never overwritten. buildStationCandidates reads the seed, not the output HTML.
changes.runner: tests/run_validation.mjs: build, ui, remaining, h0, python-reference, grid (temp), optional --publish-grid, --reproduce, --package. Writes automated-validation.json (schema 2, html_sha256, input hashes, per-step results) only when every step passes; exit 1 on failure.
changes.package: packageReview refuses when automated-validation.json is not passing, was made for another HTML hash, or the connectivity provenance does not match the current grid/model/base.

verification.seed_build_vs_baseline_html: byte-identical after mapping the two Navcam default_base_reachable values null->false (the only expected difference, because the pre-H0 connectivity report had no provenance)
verification.grid_numbers_vs_pre_H0: reachable targets, oxygen/time integrals, path edges and synthetic before/after identical
verification.temp_grid_vs_published: reachable targets and synthetic before identical; product files unchanged
verification.buildEvidence_in_temp_dir: catalog.json, common-frame-preview.svg, common-frame-points.json identical; manifest differs only in quality.runtime_s
verification.html_change_reason: map_ui.js: one caption line for unknown station reachability; connectivity values unchanged (false for both Navcam stations, now provenance-checked)

limits: Seed is the packaged payload, not a clean rebuild from raw DTM; code/build_demo_html.py full regeneration is still unverified.
Automated checks are Node VM/pure-function checks, not browser DOM or device QA.
build-reproducibility of buildEvidence was compared once; quality.runtime_s is timing and varies by run.
